author: Upton Sinclair
title: The Jungle
edition: New York: Doubleday, Page & Company, 1906. Every selected paragraph is taken from Wikisource’s scan-backed transcription of Index:The Jungle (1906).djvu (saved chapter HTML), not from Project Gutenberg 140, whose print exemplar is unidentified. Paragraph and stanza boundaries and line breaks are retained; prose layout whitespace is joined. Page numbers, running heads, and footnote callout numerals are omitted. The library text holds the dedication and Chapters I–XXXI complete; the list of other books, title page and copyright page are omitted. The edition’s two footnotes (Chapter I, “Pronounced Yoorghis.”; Chapter IX, the quoted inspection regulations) are kept in Project Gutenberg’s note form: “[1]” at the citing word and “[Footnote 1: …]” after the chapter’s last paragraph, where the transcription lists its notes, the long Chapter IX note continuing over one paragraph per section. Blocks 19–32, 37–43, 71–94, 106–112, 121–127, 143–148, 158–163 and 204–212 (Grade 11 calendar readings) were collated word by word against the scan’s Internet Archive text (jungle00sinc), differences decided on the page images, and five readings changed: “without” (block 39) and “commission-merchants” (block 90), words the page divides at a line-end hyphen, which the transcription gave as “with- out” and “commission- merchants” (the compound keeps its hyphen); and, to the printed text, “the traps”, “to her—it was”, “it was Jurgis’s task” (blocks 159, 160, 162), where it had run words together, repeated a word at a page break and dropped one; the printed “Jones” for Jonas (block 161) and “fur the cattle tails” (block 111) stand as printed.

rights.basis: The Doubleday, Page edition was published in 1906, before 1931; its US copyright term has expired as of 2026.

acquisition.method: Wikisource MediaWiki parse API (action=parse, prop=text|revid), one request for the main page and one per chapter subpage in printed order, Chapter 1 through Chapter 31 (revisions 13886195, 13885999, 13886021, 13886043, 13886049, 13886051, 13886053, 13886055, 13886057, 13886059, 14309383, 14435559, 15049553, 15049573, 15049584, 15049624, 15049675, 15049704, 15051174, 15051222, 15051242, 15051291, 15051301, 15051320, 15051371, 15079501, 15081667, 15081668, 15081701, 15081714, 15081757, 15081775, main page first). downloadSha256 is the SHA-256 of the 32 JSON responses concatenated in that order; downloadUrl is the first of them. From the main page only the dedication is kept. Wikisource headers, page-number anchors and zero-width characters removed; footnote callouts kept as “[1]” and each chapter’s reference list written after the chapter as “[Footnote 1: …]”, a line break inside a note starting a new paragraph; HTML italics dropped to plain text; whitespace collapsed to single spaces, with an inline gap rendered as one space; each HTML paragraph became a paragraph, verse with line breaks a stanza (lines trimmed); each centred chapter number became a level-2 heading and the repeated book title at Chapter I was dropped.
